title: Stock Alert Webhook Data
description: Closed projection of Stock Alert v1 that ops-core sends in `data` of the stock-below-threshold and stockout-risk-detected webhook events. Every property is the same definition as in stock-alert.schema.json; the properties that describe production planning (risk_calculation, lead_time_days, coverage_days, recommended_action, guard_block_reasons, evidence_refs) and the hold breakdown (available_stock_breakdown) are deliberately absent, so a message that carries one is invalid. The threshold that was crossed is named after the status: yellow_threshold for STOCK_YELLOW_ALERT, red_threshold for STOCK_RED_ALERT, exactly one of them; a stockout-risk-detected event carries stockout_risk_threshold. The REST stock-alert read and the domain schema are not narrowed by this file.
$comment: Source: ops-core SEC-12 (M12-082) and PL-H K5 / GAP-07. The webhook is a signal; planning detail stays in ops-core and the receiver pulls what it is entitled to. Optional keys are absent when they have no value, never null. docs/webhook-security.md section 8 is the prose side of this file.
